parameters.description: The deferred request id returned by a previous image request.
parameters.name: request_id

404.description: Unknown request id or the result has expired.

summary:
`GET /v1/images/{request_id}`: 202 while pending, 200 with `data` when
done or with `error` when failed (a failed generation is a body, not an
HTTP error, so pollers do not retry-storm).

data.description: The generated images. Present when done.

oneOf.description: Why the generation failed. Present iff `status == "failed"`.

b64_json.description: A base64-encoded string representation of the generated image (without the data-URI prefix), if `b64_json` is specified as `response_format` in the request.

oneOf.description:
Storage info for the generated image. Only present when the request
included a `storage_options` configuration and the upload succeeded.

mime_type.description: The MIME type of the generated image (e.g. `image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `image/webp`).

storage_error.description:
Human-readable error when `storage_options` was set but the upload
failed. Absent on success or when storage was not requested.

url.description: A url to the generated image, if `response_format` is not specified or with `url` in the request.

ImageError.description: Structured error returned when a deferred image generation fails.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

MediaUsage.description:
Billing and cost information for media generation requests (image and video).

The optional token fields follow the OpenAI Images API shape
(`input_tokens` / `output_tokens` / `total_tokens` with per-side detail
objects) and are populated only for image models with token-based usage
reporting. They are omitted entirely for models billed per image and for
video requests.

cost_in_usd_ticks.description:
The cost of this request expressed in USD ticks.
One USD cent equals 100,000,000 ticks, so one US dollar equals
10,000,000,000 ticks.

input_tokens.description:
Total input tokens: prompt text tokens + input image tokens
(the sum of `input_tokens_details`, where `cached_tokens` is a subset
of `text_tokens`, not additive).

output_tokens.description:
Total output tokens: rewritten-prompt text tokens + reasoning tokens
+ generated image tokens (the sum of `output_tokens_details`).

FileOutput.description: Information about a generated file stored in the Files API.

expires_at.description:
Unix timestamp (seconds) when the stored file expires and will be
automatically deleted. Only present when the file has an expiration.

file_id.description: Files API file_id of the stored file.

public_url.description:
Public URL for the stored file. Only present when the request included
`storage_options.public_url` and creation succeeded.

public_url_error.description:
Human-readable error when `storage_options.public_url` was set but
public URL creation failed. The file was stored successfully.

public_url_expires_at.description:
Unix timestamp (seconds) when the public URL expires. Present when
the public URL has an expiry, either from an explicit `expires_after`
in the request or inherited from the file's TTL.

MediaInputTokensDetails.description: Breakdown of media generation input tokens.

cached_tokens.description:
Text tokens served from cache from previous requests (a subset of
`text_tokens`).

image_tokens.description: Input image tokens, as reported by the image engine.

text_tokens.description:
Prompt text tokens consumed by the prompt-rewriting (upsampler) LLM,
including any served from cache.

MediaOutputTokensDetails.description: Breakdown of media generation output tokens.

image_tokens.description: Generated image tokens, as reported by the image engine.

reasoning_tokens.description:
Reasoning (thinking) tokens generated by the prompt-rewriting
(upsampler) LLM.

text_tokens.description:
Rewritten-prompt text tokens generated by the prompt-rewriting
(upsampler) LLM, excluding reasoning tokens.
